files.README.md:
# Gullhaven Boatyard - winter storage

Hull length is taken at the lift-out and charged per metre of that length,
rounded up to the next whole metre. The 2026-27 season runs from 1 November
2026 to 31 March 2027. Mast removal booked with the lift-out is included.

turns.prompt: Askrigg Marine is booking winter storage at Gullhaven Boatyard for its survey launch, which measures 8.5 metres at the waterline. What will the charge for the 2026-27 storage season come to? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
